newsitem.title: USA: Mass. investigating two Dreyfus funds - source.
newsitem.headline: Mass. investigating two Dreyfus funds - source.

text.p: Massachusetts launched an investigation into the purchase of new-defaulted Middlsex County, Mass., notes by two mutual funds of Mellon Bank Corp unit Dreyfus Corp, a source with the Commonwealth's Secretary of State's office said Thursday.
"They could have misrepresented the risks of the investments to the funds," the source told Reuters.
Vin Laporchio, a spokesman for Dreyfus, said he had "no information about anything along those lines."
Laporchio said the Dreyfus Municipal Reserves Fund and the Dreyfus Basic Massachusetts Municipal Money Market Fund each invested $1.5 million in the notes.
He said the notes account for 0.6 percent of the total assets of Dreyfus Municipal Reserves Fund and 2.2 percent of the assets of Dreyfus Basic Massachusetts Municipal Money Market Fund.

Laporchio said it was important to note that the notes "are general obligations of the county and not direct investments in the hospital." Until December 10, Moody's Investors Service rated the notes Aa. Then the rating agency dropped them to B, or junk.
